records.issue_text: Recovery-code validation does not consume matching codes or persist their used status, and getCredentials() reconstructs credentials from the original code list, allowing successfully used codes to be replayed indefinitely.
records.rationale: Looking at the diff, the BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.isValid() method for RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.TYPE simply checks if the input code exists in the stored list (generatedKeys.stream().anyMatch(key -> key.equals(input.getChallengeResponse()))) but never removes or marks the code as used.
